hook: You got the raise. A year later your savings look exactly the same. In this video I go through 20 ways your raise disappears, from three angles: the money leaks (taxes, housing, cars, subscriptions), the psychology (the hedonic treadmill, new peers, status brands) and the long-term leaks, plus the 50/50 raise rule that lets you enjoy every raise and still get richer.
shorts: Where did your raise go? Probably here.
Why every upgrade becomes your new normal
The raise rule that makes you rich instead of busy
Two coworkers got the same raises. One got rich.
